title: Three women survived a deadly Grand Canyon flood after clinging to a rock ledge for 5 hours
summary_full: Three women survived a dangerous flash flood in the Grand Canyon. They clung to a rock ledge for five hours while debris swept past.  Separated briefly, each feared the others had been lost to the waters.  A rescue helicopter eventually spotted the stranded hikers and brought them to safety.  This survival occurred during a larger disaster which claimed other lives.
